name: blur-vignette-card
title: Blur Vignette Card
description: Two square image cards with blurred vignette edges and a frosted caption strip at the bottom. Hovering slides the caption up and fades in a short paragraph while the artwork zooms slightly.
use: You want image tiles to keep their look clean while hiding a short description until hover.
avoid: The description only appears on hover, so touch and keyboard users never see it.
a11y: The caption paragraph appears on hover only, so keyboard and touch users cannot read it. (keyboard: no, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two square cards side by side on black, each a comic-style illustration with its outer edges softened into the page. A frosted strip across the bottom holds a white title; one card shows a caped hero over a city, the other a pumpkin figure under a full moon.
behaves: At rest each card shows only its title on a frosted strip near the bottom edge. On hover the strip slides up and the small body paragraph fades in while the artwork scales up gently; it settles back when the pointer leaves.
customise: The two card entries — image URL, title and body — live in a local array, so edit them there. Corner radius, inset, fade length and blur come from the vignette wrapper props.
weight: light: Two image cards with backdrop-blur caption strips and CSS hover transitions.
demo: A caped comic hero over a city, and a pumpkin figure in purple moonlight.
issues: Revealed body copy is tiny and sits directly on busy artwork, so it is hard to read.
Captions open on hover only, leaving touch and keyboard users with just the title.
polishWhy: Tidy cards with a smooth caption slide; the revealed body text is very small.
